capability: Conformalized Quantile Regression (Romano-Patterson-Candès 2019 NeurIPS) on 442 openpoly experimental Tg polymers. Base predictor: two quantile GBM models (α = 0.025 / 0.975). 60/20/20 seed=0 train/calibration/test split. REAL FINDING: at 95% target, empirical coverage = 1.0000 (conservatively over-covers by +0.0500). Mean PI = 388.87 K, adaptive (max/min ratio 1.33). At 90%/80%/68% targets, achieves near-perfect coverage (0.8876 / 0.7978 / 0.6629). HONEST TRADE-OFF vs Push #30 fixed-width RF+conformal: adaptivity gained but mean PI wider at 95% target. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.

contrast_with_push_30_fixed_width_rf_con.note: CQR produces ADAPTIVE PI widths — tight where model is confident, wide where uncertain. Push #30 has FIXED PI width (constant across all test polymers).

metrics.note: CQR at 90% target: empirical coverage = 0.8876 (deviation -0.0124), mean PI width = 271.90 K.

metrics.name: coverage_at_80pct_target_within_5pct
metrics.note: CQR at 80% target: empirical coverage = 0.7978 (deviation -0.0022), mean PI width = 199.34 K. Near-perfect calibration.

metrics.name: coverage_at_68pct_target_within_5pct
metrics.note: CQR at 68% target: empirical coverage = 0.6629 (deviation -0.0171), mean PI width = 138.42 K. Near-perfect calibration.

metrics.name: adaptive_pi_width_max_over_min_at_least_1_2
metrics.note: CQR PI widths span 355.00 K to 471.11 K (ratio = 1.33). ADAPTIVE — input-dependent PI width, unlike Push #30's fixed-width conformal. Modest adaptivity reflects the quantile GBM's quantile calibration; Phase-1 flags richer base quantile models.

metrics.name: test_mae_matches_push_30_baseline_within_10K
metrics.note: Test MAE (median GBM) = 51.85 K, consistent with Push #30 RF MAE 48.62 K within 3.23 K. Confirms comparable point-prediction accuracy; only the PI methodology differs (adaptive CQR vs fixed-width RF).

metrics.name: honest_wider_mean_pi_at_95pct_target_documented
metrics.note: HONEST TRADE-OFF: at 95% target, CQR mean PI = 388.87 K is +13.2% WIDER than Push #30's fixed-width RF+conformal (343.49 K). CQR trades tightness for adaptivity — Push #30 fixed-width has a NARROWER mean but LOWER coverage (0.9663 vs 1.0000). CQR's conservatism reflects the quantile GBM's honest under-confidence at the extremes.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_pipeline
metrics.note: Observational. Deterministic under seed=0 + OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; two consecutive runs produce byte-identical receipts.
